text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—I won't lose! I won't...! I will beat... 
Heart-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, Craft...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—There's no way I'm losing! The one who 
wins... is me!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(—Competing against each other like that. 
I wonder why...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(I didn't want to cross the finish line 
yet. —I was wishing that time would just 
stop.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah... haah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Did I win?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "To Craft... Could I have...?"
choice_data_list: Yeah. You are the winner... Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Nghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Victory is mine!! Victory... belongs to 
me!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Splendid running from both of you. ...Next 
is my turn.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...What... heat—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Gh, I'm sorry, I can't... stop the 
tears. Because I wanted to... blaze this 
trail myself...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: “Still... Still...! ...Congratulations.”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Congratulations! Heart...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Craft. This victory is――

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's all because you were there with me. 
Thank you—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, you're... quite passionate, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Even Mr. Heart...! Ugh... 
*sob*!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Great work, you two!!" "That was 
ridiculously hype~~~~!!" "I'M PROUD OF 
YOOOU!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Craft. I was just thinking about 
something weird.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I wanted so badly to beat you. And yet—I 
just wanted to keep running with you 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...! Heart-san...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Craft. You helplessly captivate my 
heart... my special rival."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Next...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Heart & Craft
text_block_list.text: At the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I understand now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"What I was searching for was right here 
all along."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A clash of hearts with my rival. To race 
with her—that's why I came to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's why, from now on too... I want to 
keep running against her forever.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Burning, yearning, pounding endlessly—I 
want to keep fighting my best rival!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Until then... I have to get much stronger.
choice_data_list:
We also have the summer training camp 
coming up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume grow significantly during the 
summer. The summer camp is an annual 
opportunity held to support and improve 
their skills.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Once we get through the summer—I'm sure 
everyone will have grown even more than 
they have now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Not just Craft. ...Cesario and the 
others, too."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could I ask for your help again? 
Just like back in the Junior Class.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Let's do it!
